messages.content: is i thought the shop was open the same as i think the shop is open?
i thought gives an idea you had before now. i think gives an idea you have now.
can you use both in one reply?
i thought the shop was closed, but now i think it is open.
can i say i thought it was open, but it is closed?
yes. you had the idea that it was open, but now you know it is closed.
only give that example sentence.
i thought it was open, but it is closed.
what if i still do not know whether it is open?
you can say: i think the shop is open, but i have not checked.
why not say i know?
because knowing and thinking are different. if you have not checked and are not sure, i think keeps that part clear.
now ask someone who has just been there.
was the shop open when you were there?
would that tell me it is still open now?
not for sure. it gives the time of their visit. the shop could have closed after they left.
write a longer story about a child finding an old tool. the tool should not work now, but the person keeping it should have a reason.

a child found an old tool in a container under a desk. he asked his grandfather whether they could use it to fix a chair. his grandfather said that a part was broken and that he used another tool for work now. the child asked why he still kept the old one. his grandfather told him it was the first tool his father had taught him to use. it helped him remember learning at the kitchen table when he was young. the child put it back and asked to hear more about that day. later, when they fixed the chair, they used the tool that worked. the old one stayed in its place as part of a story, not as something they needed for that task.
why did they not use the old tool for the chair?
a part was broken, and the grandfather had another tool that worked.
did being important to him make the old tool work again?
no. its meaning to him and whether it worked were different things.
what did the child learn about why it was kept?
it helped his grandfather remember learning from his own father.
write a question the child could ask about that memory.
what did your father teach you to make with this tool?
can you answer that from the story?
no. the story does not give the first thing they made. that would be a new detail to add if we wanted more story.
finish with the two using the working tool.
his grandfather showed him how to hold the other tool. they worked slowly on the chair while talking about the old one.
my friend sent a message asking how my week was. it was a small thing, but i liked that they asked.
it can feel good when someone makes room to hear about your week. did you want to tell them many things or keep it short?
short. nothing big happened, but i want them to know i liked hearing from them.
you could say: my week was quiet. it was nice to hear from you. how was yours?
can that sound like i do not want to talk?
not by itself. you answer and ask about their week too. that gives them something to reply to.
make that explanation shorter.
the question gives them a way to answer and keep talking.
what if i do not want to ask a question now?
then leave it out. you could say: my week was quiet. it was nice to hear from you.
can i add that i will write more when i have time?
yes, if that is what you want to do. you can say: i will write more when i have a little time.
only give the message without that plan.
my week was quiet. it was nice to hear from you.
why not say the week was really good?
you said you liked the message, but did not say the whole week was really good. quiet keeps the detail you gave.
what does kind mean in a kind person and what kind of book?
a kind person can help and care about other people. what kind of book asks about the type of book.
only give the explanation about kind of book.
what kind of book asks about the type of book.
now only give the explanation about a kind person.
a kind person can help and care about other people.
give me a small conversation using both.
what kind of book are you reading? it is a story about a kind person who helps a neighbor.
does kind always mean the person says yes to everything?
no. a kind person can say no and still care about someone. saying yes to every request is not the only way to be kind.
make that explanation shorter.
a kind person can say no and still care.
now only give a question with kind of.
what kind of story would you like to read?
answer with a simple choice.
i would like a quiet story about a family.
write a story about someone finding a note in a book and learning it was not written for the person holding the book now.

a woman took a book from the library and found a note between two pages. it said to meet near the school after lunch. she did not know who had written it or who should read it. she took it to the person working at the library. the worker remembered seeing it with another person who had used the book before her. they explained that the message had not been written for her. she did not need to make a new plan from it. she left the note with the worker and went back to reading the book she had chosen.
why did finding the note not make it a request for her?
the worker explained that it was a message from someone who had used the book before her. holding the book now did not make the request one for her.
why did she ask about the note instead of going to the school?
she did not know who it was for or when it was written. those details were important before using it as a plan.
can a note inside a book be part of the story?
yes, if it was written as part of the story. but this one was a note left by another person, from what the worker told her.
can she know why the person left it there?
not from finding one note. people can leave something behind for different reasons.
finish with her reading instead of going to the school.
she gave the note to the worker, sat near the window, and opened the book to the first page.
what was her real task at the library?
she wanted to read the book she had chosen.
i bought five objects and returned two to the shop. how many did i keep?
you kept three objects.
now i buy one different object.
then you have four objects from what you bought and kept.
explain how that number is made.
you kept three of the first five, then bought one different object. three and one make four.
how many different objects did i buy in all, even if i did not keep them?
you first bought five. later you bought one different object, making six different objects bought in all.
make that explanation shorter.
you bought six different objects in all: five first, then one different object later. you returned two of the first five.
if i ask how many i have now, should you answer six?
no. you have four now, because two were returned.
can you know how much money i got back?
no. you did not give the price of the two objects or what the shop gave back.
only give the number i kept at the very end.
four objects.
write a story about a child asking for help carrying books, but the person helping thinks the child wants all the books moved. the child should explain the smaller task.

a child stood near a shelf with books on every level. he asked his sister to help carry some to the table. she began taking books from the top, thinking he wanted the shelf empty. he stopped her and said that he only wanted the books for their reading that afternoon. she asked him to point to the right group before she moved more. he showed her three books on the middle level. they carried those together and left the rest where they were. the request had been for help with one part of the shelf, not a change to the whole room.
why did the sister start with the top books?
she thought he wanted the whole shelf empty and began with one part of it.
what information did she need at first?
which books he wanted moved and how much of the shelf the task was about.
say that in a full sentence.
at first, he had not said which books to move or that the other books should stay.
write his more specific request.
could you help me carry these three books from the middle shelf to the table? the rest can stay where they are.
can you know those three books are his?
no. asking for help moving books does not tell us whose they are.
finish with them reading at the table.
they put the three books down and chose one to read first. the shelf still held the rest.
my brother moved his things so i could use the table. help me thank him without a long message.
thanks for making space for me at the table.
can i name what it helped me do? i wanted to write a letter.
thanks for making space at the table. it helped me write my letter.
what if i have not written it yet?
then do not say it already helped you write it. you could say: thanks for making space at the table. now i can write my letter.
only give that message.
thanks for making space at the table. now i can write my letter.
why is can different from did there?
can says the space gives you a way to write. did would say the writing happened. you have not said you wrote the letter yet.
now i finished it. make the thanks about that.
thanks for making space at the table. i finished my letter there.
can you make it shorter?
thanks for the space. i finished my letter.
now just the thank you again.
thanks for making space for me at the table.
